qualification.education_qualification: PhD in Health Sciences / MD Community Medicine / MD in Ophthalmology
qualification.details: Post Doctoral Fellow: PhD in Health Sciences, MD Community Medicine, MD in Ophthalmology. Candidates must have completed their PhD or MD within the four years preceding the date of interview. Candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis and are awaiting final defence are also eligible to attend. Desirable: Certification in data management/experience in statistical software- STATA/R/SPSS/RedCap, Minimum of two publications.

selection_process: Written test of qualifying nature for initial screening (depending on the number of candidates) Walk-in-interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification.
Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview.
Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology, Trivandrum (SCTIMST).

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in SCTIMST recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Post Doctoral Fellow under a foreign funded research project at SCTIMST.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Post Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Post Doctoral Fellow position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Post Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Health Sciences, MD Community Medicine, or MD in Ophthalmology along with the specified completion criteria.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants applying for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on 01.10.2026, with applicable age relaxations for government research organisation experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or consolidated pay for the Post Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 1,10,000/- for the duration of the contract.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for SCTIMST Post Doctoral Fellow 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 26 October 2026 at the designated institute venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of selection for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test of qualifying nature for initial screening (if necessary) followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their bio-data, original certificates, and self-attested copies of certificates proving age, qualification, and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to report for the interview at the Ground floor of the AMCHSS building, SCTIMST, Thiruvananthapuram.
